IDU Exported Functions

group IDU_Exported_Functions

Functions for IDU initialization, configuration and operation.

Functions

void IDU_INTConfig(IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE Interrupt, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable/Disable IDU interrupt.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    IDU_INTConfig(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT, ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • Interrupt -- [in] Specified interrupt type from IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the IDU interrupt.

    • ENABLE: Enable specified interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable specified interrupt.

ITStatus IDU_GetINTStatus(IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE Interrupt)

Get interrupt status of IDU.

参数:

Interrupt -- [in] Specified interrupt type from IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE.

返回值:

  • - -- SET: Interrupt has been triggered.

  • - -- RESET: Interrupt has not been triggered yet. Example usage 

    void demo_code(void){
    ITStatus status = IDU_GetINTStatus(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT);
}

返回:

Interrupt status

void IDU_MaskINTConfig(IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE Interrupt, FunctionalState NewState)

Mask or unmask specified IDU interrupt.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    // Mask IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT interrupt
    IDU_MaskINTConfig(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT, ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • Interrupt -- [in] Specified interrupt type from IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE.

  • NewState -- [in] Mask or unmask the IDU interrupt.

    • ENABLE: Mask specified interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Unmask specified interrupt.

void IDU_ClearINTPendingBit(IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE Interrupt)

Clear status of specified IDU interrupt.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    IDU_ClearINTPendingBit(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT);
}

参数:

Interrupt -- [in] Specified interrupt type from IDU_INTERRUPT_TYPE.

IDU_ERROR IDU_Decode(uint8_t *file, IDU_decode_range *range, IDU_DMA_config *dma_cfg)

IDU decode function, decode file from memory/flash.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_IDU, APBPeriph_IDU_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    IDU_file_header* header = (IDU_file_header*)file_data;
    IDU_decode_range range = {0, header->raw_pic_height - 1, 0, header->raw_pic_width - 1, 204};
    IDU_DMA_config dma_cfg;
    dma_cfg.output_buf = (uint32_t*)buf;
    dma_cfg.RX_DMA_channel_num = 0;
    dma_cfg.TX_DMA_channel_num = 1;
    IDU_ERROR err = IDU_Decode(file_data, &range, &dma_cfg);
}

参数:

  • file -- [in] Pointer to header of compressed image.

  • range -- [in] Decompress range, refer to IDU_decode_range.

  • dma_cfg -- [in] Determine which DMA channel is selected, refer to IDU_DMA_config.

返回值:

  • - -- IDU_SUCCESS: Operation success.

  • - -- Others: Operation failure, cause refers to IDU Error Code.

返回:

Operation result

IDU_ERROR IDU_Decode_With_Interrupt(uint8_t *file, IDU_decode_range *range, IDU_DMA_config *dma_cfg, IDU_interrupt_config int_cfg)

IDU decode function with interrupt, decode file from memory/flash.

Example usage 

void IDU_Handler(void){
    if(IDU_GetINTStatus(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT) == SET){
        IDU_ClearINTPendingBit(IDU_DECOMPRESS_FINISH_INT);
        //User operation
    }
    if(IDU_GetINTStatus(IDU_DECOMPRESS_ERROR_INT) == SET){
        IDU_ClearINTPendingBit(IDU_DECOMPRESS_ERROR_INT);
        //User operation
    }
}
void demo_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_IDU, APBPeriph_IDU_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    IDU_file_header* header = (IDU_file_header*)file_data;
    IDU_decode_range range = {0, header->raw_pic_height - 1, 0, header->raw_pic_width - 1, 0};
    IDU_DMA_config dma_cfg;
    dma_cfg.output_buf = (uint32_t*)buf;
    dma_cfg.RX_DMA_channel_num = 0;
    dma_cfg.TX_DMA_channel_num = 1;
    IDU_interrupt_config int_cfg = {0};
    int_cfg.idu_decompress_finish_int = 1;
    int_cfg.idu_decompress_error_int = 1;
    IDU_ERROR err = IDU_Decode_With_Interrupt(file_data, &range, &dma_cfg, int_cfg);
}

参数:

  • file -- [in] Pointer to header of compressed image.

  • range -- [in] Decompress range, refer to IDU_decode_range.

  • dma_cfg -- [in] Determine which DMA channel is selected, refer to IDU_DMA_config.

  • int_cfg -- [in] Determine which interrupts are enabled, refer to IDU_interrupt_config.

返回值:

  • - -- IDU_SUCCESS: Operation success.

  • - -- Others: Operation failure, cause refers to IDU Error Code.

返回:

Operation result

uint32_t IDU_Get_Line_Start_Address(uint32_t compressed_start_address, uint32_t line_number)

Get the start address of certain line in compressed file.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    uint32_t file_address = (uint32_t)SAMPLE_FILE;
    uint32_t line_addr = IDU_Get_Line_Start_Address(file_address, 100);
}

参数:

  • compressed_start_address -- [in] start address of entire compressed file.

  • line_number -- [in] specified line number

返回值:

  • - -- 0: Invalid line number.

  • - -- others: Valid address.

返回:

start address of specified line

uint8_t IDU_Get_Pixel_Size(IDU_file_header *file)

Get the pixel size of compressed image.

Example usage 

void demo_code(void){
    IDU_file_header* file = (IDU_file_header*)SAMPLE_FILE;
    uint8_t pixel_size = IDU_Get_Pixel_Size(file);
    uint32_t decompressed_image_size = file->raw_pic_width * file->raw_pic_height * pixel_size;
}

参数:

file -- [in] Pointer to header of compressed image.

返回值:

  • - -- 0xFF: Invalid header.

  • - -- Others: Actual pixel size.

返回:

Pixel size of compressed image
